title: Should I drink more water?
summary: Usually yes if your urine is dark or you feel thirsty — that is most of the answer.

blocks.title: If you are thirsty or your urine is dark, drink water
blocks.body: That is the page. Most healthy people can trust thirst and urine color more than a viral gallon-a-day rule.

blocks.title: When to ask a clinician instead
blocks.body: Kidney disease, heart failure, endurance events, or medications that change fluid balance need personal medical advice — not a grading-night micro-page.
